ledger.detail: State coordinates, convexity, affine effects and compactness are over the existing complete ordered field of real numbers and Euclidean topology. This repair does not derive real/complex completion from finite data.
Effect S includes every ambient affine real functional bounded between zero and one on S. A restricted operational effect theory would need a separate interface and preservation checks.

Nonempty compact convex state set with full affine span; positive capacity bounds every genuinely distinguishable pure frame and is attained. dim is n+1. A concrete System0 witness is checked; no general System construction is asserted.

Products map valid pairs into AB, are separately affine, and have affine state-preserving left/right marginals with marginal/product identities. Ball exclusion uses the right marginal, left nonemptiness and right product section. It does not require product-purity.

Requires actual geometric System models for arithmetic tags, dimension and rank calibration, classical finite-polytope geometry, and qubit affine three-ball charts. No Jordan multiplication or concrete global catalogue is constructed.

An actual affine equivalence onto the chosen catalogue state set and capacity equality are supplied. Dimension equality is derived; capacity preservation is a required certificate field, not proved here to follow from the affine equivalence.

A supplied proof would classify every repaired spectral strongly symmetric System into a catalogue model and give the simple/classical dichotomy. No instance, invocation, or proof is supplied. The geometric exclusion theorem does not use this contract.

Representations RA,RB,RAB; simple/classical dichotomy of RAB; AB.dim=A.dim*B.dim; A.rank*B.rank<=AB.rank; A.rank>=2; B.rank=2; B.dim=4. These are not derived from operational local tomography or a tensor-product theorem here.

Pinned Lean 4.33.1 and Mathlib commit 0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474; existing compiled Mathlib cache is reused. New modules are rebuilt from source. Standard logical axiom receipts are not a statement that theorem hypotheses are absent.

The records collect reusable conditional proof operations. Only unary real-affine image unit/substitution/associativity laws are formalized. No full higher-arity colored operad, tensor coherence, or process equivalence is proved.
